integrity: All stated cellular ranks, nine-by-nine integral minors, and index-two maximal minors are reproduced from the graph by a standalone standard-library Python program; no independent scientific audit or external certification is claimed.
limitations: The minimum total cycle length is restricted to embedded tori from two vertex-disjoint simple cycles on the specified Tietze graph. The theorem does not classify arbitrary singular homology cycles, other particle numbers, or other vertex expansions. An inaccessible full thesis remains a bibliographic originality risk.
title: The Tietze graph has a sharp length-eleven integral torus basis and an index-two parity obstruction
